transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. transcript.text: I need to flag a serious issue I found this morning. transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two accessibility requirements from my test. First, the digital edition must be delivered as a tagged PDF. Second, every catalog image needs approved alt text of no more than 150 characters. My test report is still awaiting attachment to the delivery checklist, so these requirements aren't visible to the rest of you yet.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a sponsor contract issue. I confirmed in the sponsor contract that the sponsor logo may not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait, and the acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.'
